implement_adapter_protocol: implement a new Adapter class that wraps a denoising model and defines the forward method
stack_adapters: stack multiple Adapter instances together to augment a base denoising model before passing to a Sampler
call_adapter_forward: call the forward method on an Adapter with an input tensor, timestep, and optional conditional inputs
check_adapter_type: use isinstance with the runtime_checkable Adapter Protocol to verify a model implements the Adapter interface
review_adapter_forward_signature: review the Adapter forward method signature to understand required input tensor, timestep, and conditional_inputs parameters
